info.title: semantic-router 0.6.1: route each prompt to local models, subscription CLIs or paid APIs.
info.description: A ready-to-run semantic prompt router: point Claude Code, Codex or any OpenAI/Anthropic client at it and it picks local models, subscription CLIs or paid APIs per turn. Includes the dashboard. Install with `dotnet tool install -g SemanticRouter.Host`.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check every connector, model and the embeddings, and list every host the

options.name: --config-dir
options.description:
Configuration directory. Default: $SEMANTIC_ROUTER_HOME, else
%APPDATA%\semantic-router, ~/Library/Application Support/semantic-router
or ~/.config/semantic-router.

options.name: --urls
options.description:
Where to listen, e.g. http://localhost:5080 (the default). Binding beyond this machine
needs a dashboard token for remote dashboard use; see https://siebe41.github.io/SemanticRouter.NET/dashboard#access-and-security.

options.name: --no-detect
options.description: init: write the template without probing this machine.

options.name: --yes
options.description: init: enable the claude and codex CLIs it finds without asking.

options.name: --enable-cli
options.description: (claude, codex, copilot); the others it finds are added disabled.

options.name: --no-cli
options.description:
init: add no subscription CLI connectors (claude, codex, copilot). Wins over
--yes and --enable-cli.

options.name: --SemanticRouter
options.description:
Override any setting, like the SemanticRouter__<key> environment variables.
Files in the configuration directory:
semantic-router.json           The configuration; the dashboard saves here.
semantic-router.secrets.json   Keys typed into the dashboard, encrypted.
semantic-router.evaluation.jsonl  Labelled prompts for the dashboard's Evaluate page.
semantic-router.db             Cooldowns, tool-call affinity, activity and configuration history.
semantic-router.instance.json  The running router's process id and addresses, while it runs.
appsettings.json               Optional: host settings (logging, Kestrel, SemanticRouter overrides).
semantic-router.host.json      Where to listen, as the dashboard's Admin → Service page saves it; --urls wins.
